validation_selection.latest_request_scope: Only checkpoints trained on new COCO + Open Images data are eligible.
validation_selection.selection_data: combined validation only; frozen/external test not used for selection

data.labels_policy: COCO authoritative for mapped COCO classes; LVIS companion labels. Open Images preserves all compatible mapped boxes, excluding group/depiction images.

weighting.purpose: Explicit sampling weight for requested toothbrush class; repeats are not new photographs.

deployment: training candidate only; existing Jetson deployment unchanged by this experiment
selection_policy: Validation only; test evaluated after checkpoint selection and not used to change selection.
